request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, skin and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Nobody looks at the camera. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

A close photograph of the rustic wooden counter of a covered market stall, softly blurred market behind. On the counter, side by side with a clear gap, are one blue pen on the left and one red pen on the right, each lying in front of its own small white price card standing behind it, hand-written in black marker, large and sharp. BOTH cards read exactly $3: the two prices are the same. Exactly two pens and two cards; no people, no hands and nothing else on the counter. The only writing in the photo is the two price cards.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
